name: Miset
source: A self-proclaimed phantom thief who first appears while impersonating [url=https://vndb.org/c151998]Master[/url]'s appearance. Also a wholesome cross-dresser. He comes from a family of sorcerers, which allows him to use magic and teleport at will.
